Manx: ta logh moiroil roshtyn veih'n derrey chione
gys y chione elley jeh ny shooylaghan
as ta ushtey freilt liorish boalley as cassyn mygeayrt-y-mysh
ta'n logh lhieent ec y
shen as lurg y vooir-hraie
foddee fer shooyl mygeayrt
er y traie ain er-gerrey da'n shooylaghan
va raaue currit dooin gyn dy goll faggys da'n logh
shen yn oyr nagh ren mee rieau gynsaghey snaue
as my ayr as my voir snaue noadyr
ta ymmodee jeh nyn shennayraghyn
ayn nagh dod gamylt
cha row yn chooish jeh scansh mooar daue
dy jarroo va ram eeasteyryn as shiolteyryn
nieu ard-niart dy ynsaghey
er-lhieu dy beagh ad skeabit harrish y voayrd veih'n baatey
bare lhieu geddyn baase dy tappee
as gleck rish ooryn snaue
aghterbee un laa hie mee as genney three guillyn elley
hooar mygeayrt y logh cha row shin booiagh dy chooyl er y cassyn
begin dooin shooyl er mullagh y voalley nish
cha nel ushtey ec y kione jiass
as myr ta'n tidey cheet harrish y woalley lesh y vooir lane ta'n woalley s'laue
lesh famlagh ny keayrt s'mie shen
va shin jannoo dy mie roish haink shin gys y jerrey
scuirr mee as hug mee stiagh ayns yn ushtey
ta mee er ghra cha dod mee snaue
as mannagh beagh dooinney seyr va er gerrey
as maidjey shooyl echey oddins v'eh ve veih
nish cre dy yannoo cha b'leayst dou goll thie
dy aighoil va laad shey
grianagh as veih kione
eddyr y traie as y raad yiarn
cha row veg agh magheryn as croink jeh
ooilley my hene faagail eh grian dy hirmaghey
choud's va mish roie mygeayrt jiarg rooisht
derrey va my eadneeyn cooie dy cummoom rish
cha dinsh mee da fer erbee mysh cooish
rish shiartanse dy vleeantyn ny lurg shen
as my huyr my vagher my voir magh dy row mee er duittym ayns y logh
cha dooyrt ee veg dooys ta mee goll dy scoill
thieyn thooit sy chenn valley beg was keirdee
kiart gollrish ny thieyn thooit syn ellan ain
son nagh row ad troggit ass cloghyn
v'ad enmyssit sy vaarle lieh
as v'ad booiagh dy jarroo ta fys mie aym
dy vel ad troggal kishtaghyn beggey lieh-fuyghit
ayns yn ellan just nish agh t'adsyn myr dy beagh ad jeant jeh boallaghyn aile
ayns co-soyley rish ny shenn thieyn trooid
lieh cooie da dagh gharmin ayndoo
jeh fuygh darragh trome as
rish fer elley lesh bishagh quoi
va'n folmid eddyr ny
eddyr ny darraghyn lhieent seose lesh breekyn
as ad er mullagh y thie
cha s'ayms c'red va rouyr thoo coonlagh
foddee va jeant ass y phair liauyr as rheynn
ta gaase er ny croink gennee rish y traie
gyn dooyt va ny shenn thieyn thooit troggit keeadyn dy vleeantyn
as foddee t'ad shassoo foddee ta yindys earroo
cur ren mee goaill lheid tashtit da'n obbyr persoonee
choud's va mee foast ec y scoill
cha lhiass diu goaill yindys edyr
mac da seyr thie as mainshtyr masoonagh
aghterbee s'liooar shen
va caa ain baghey ayns nane jeh ny shenn thieyn thooit
sy chenn valley beg as va kuse dy cabbil as assylyn echey
dy varkiagh er genniagh traie ny marrey
ny keayrtyn er y lhiggin
lurg y vooir-hraie yinnagh eh turrys y yannoo
lesh cabbyl as fainagh ga whaiyl
gys ennis goaill goaldee marish
dy cur shilley er yn innys hie my huyr as mish marish laa dy row
agh cha noddym cooinaghtyn er monney mychione y voayl
as cha nel mee er ve ayns shen neayr's y traa shen
keayrt ny ghaa ta mish as my chaarjyn
ny nish tra va'n tidey foddey mooie
cha row shin as va kuse dy
faagit va ro ghaun dooinney
